capabilities: Search DuckDuckGo without API keys and insert a footnote citation at the cursor
Auto-number sequential footnotes and append formatted references to the note
Fact-check claims with an LLM and show color-coded verdict badges with confidence scores
Open search results in the browser without dismissing the modal
Refine the pre-filled query and scroll to load more results
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says community-plugin installation is available 'when published', implying manual installation may still be needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search the web and turn a selection into a verified, numbered footnote citation without leaving the note or managing footnote numbering by hand.

relations.evidence: Powered by DuckDuckGo with a resilient 3-layer strategy (HTML → Lite → Instant Answer API).

summary: Citation tool that searches DuckDuckGo from a modal and inserts sequential Markdown footnotes under the cursor, with optional LLM fact-checking.
